caption: The drawing depicts two views of an oval box: a top view and a side view. Both views show a decorative motif consisting predominantly of orange as the background color, interspersed with large, stylized patterns in yellow and light green. The designs include elongated, paisley-like shapes and rounded forms that are surrounded by green leaves with yellow veins. There are also small circular or dot-like elements in yellow and green scattered throughout the pattern. The box has a dark brown border along its edges, which is visible from both the top and side perspectives. The lid of the box appears slightly raised above the base in the side view, and the lines suggest the box is constructed from wood or a wood-like material. The drawing is executed in watercolor or a similar medium, giving the colors a soft, blended appearance. The artist’s name, "FRANCES L. LIEITEN," is written in small letters at the bottom right of the page.
title: Pa. German Cap Box
